text:
maya: Quick Q — how should the CLI/SDK handle API key rotation when org- and project-scoped keys exist? Our starter-kit .env is ambiguous and customers hit auth errors after rotating keys.

oliver: We need a clear fallback order + an interactive re-auth flow. Proposal: prefer REDWOOD_TOKEN (generic), then REDWOOD_PROJECT_<PROJECT_ID>_API_KEY, then REDWOOD_ORG_<ORG_ID>_API_KEY. CLI: detect 401 and prompt `rw login --rotate` rather than blind retries.

samir: Strong +1 to not retry on 401. Retrying with the same token just wastes quota and obscures the error. For 429/5xx we should do exponential backoff. Also recommend we return a distinct auth failure code so apps can surface precise UX.

maya: One thought — simpler env pattern for samples: use REDWOOD_TOKEN and REDWOOD_SCOPE=project:<id> or org:<id>. Keeps examples compact and easier for new users.

oliver: That helps UX but risks divergence from existing SDK env var parsing. Compromise: document REDWOOD_TOKEN+REDWOOD_SCOPE as the preferred simple method in starter-kit, and have SDKs fallback to legacy vars for CI/backwards compatibility.

samir: Don't forget CI: many pipelines inject REDWOOD_API_KEY. Keep compatibility for that var. Also add a CLI command `rw token refresh --source=env|cli|file` to explicitly rotate/refresh tokens during deploys.

devex-bot: Docs draft posted: https://docs.redwood.ai/devex/auth-scope-fallbacks (draft) :eyes:

liz: I can do the starter-kit update and doc PR. I'll add a short "rotation checklist" for on-call and a small step-by-step for users who rotated keys and hit 401s.

maya: Example .env snippet for the starter-kit: 

```
# preferred simple form
REDWOOD_TOKEN=rgx_abc123
REDWOOD_SCOPE=project:proj-xyz

# legacy fallbacks (supported by SDKs)
REDWOOD_API_KEY=rgx_abc123
REDWOOD_PROJECT_PROJ-XYZ_API_KEY=rgx_abc123
```

samir: SDKs should expose a machine-readable auth error (e.g., code `AUTH_ROTATED`) and a callback hook `onAuthFailure` so web/mobile apps can trigger interactive re-login flows. For servers, return 401 with header `x-redwood-auth-action: rotate` to help infra identify rotation cases.

oliver: Implementation note: JS/Python/Go SDKs must implement the same parsing order and emit unified telemetry events when a fallback variable is used (helps us find users relying on legacy vars). I'll file parity tickets.

maya: Action items: liz -> docs + starter-kit PR, oliver -> SDK parity tickets, samir -> retry-policy + error-code PR. I'll update the starter-kit issue with the suggested .env snippet.

maya: Thanks — if no objections I'll mark this resolved.

samir: fine by me.
